multimodal-core.description: Full multimodal audit of any website genre with the core families A–C.

multimodal-datastory.description: Multimodal audit plus the interactive data-story module (DAT-01 to DAT-04). Use for explorable explanations and visualization-heavy pages such as DSC 106 final projects.

multimodal-datastory-media.description: Multimodal data-story audit plus optional media inspection (MED-01).

text-only-core.description: Reduced-capability audit from text, DOM, style, interaction, and source records only. Every check that needs screenshots is unassessed. Never ranked together with multimodal runs.

text-only-datastory.description: Reduced-capability data-story audit. Chart-reading checks that need screenshots are unassessed unless a data excerpt is supplied.

selection_rules: desktop viewport 1280x800 at DPR 1: viewport screenshots at scroll offsets 0, 1 viewport height, and 2 viewport heights (3 images, fewer if the page is shorter)
mobile viewport 390x844 at DPR 2: viewport screenshots at scroll offsets 0 and 1 viewport height (2 images)
one before/after interaction pair: reuse an existing screenshot as the before image when it already shows the before state (1 or 2 images)
one full-page overview at the desktop viewport (1 image); fine text must be read from viewport screenshots or text spans, never from the shrunken overview
pilot-8.note: An example pilot budget. It does not guarantee full-page inspection; actual selection and coverage are recorded in each bundle.

selection_rules: Images chosen by hand or by a capture plan; the plan and coverage must be recorded in the manifest.
custom.note: For supplied bundles that do not follow pilot-8.

selection_rules: pages: the entry URL plus pages linked from it that stay on the same host and under the URL's folder; robots.txt honored; at most 12 pages by default
regions: each page's top-level sections, detected automatically and named by their own heading
desktop 1280x800 viewport tiles from one budget (64 by default): the top of every page, the entry page top to bottom, then other pages spread top to bottom as space allows
phone 390x844 at DPR 2: the top of the entry page, and of other pages if images remain
text and controls collected while scrolling through each page, so reveal-on-scroll content is included
each safe control clicked once on a fresh load (at most 10 per page); typing, dragging, form submission, downloads, and account or payment actions are never performed
site-auto.note: Written by integrations/capture/site_capture.py for the one-line URL command. Coverage of long pages is recorded per page; text is captured for whole pages even where screenshots are spread out.
